arabic text: KARBALAA KE DASHT MEN ZAINAB PE TANHAAI NA HO\nWO GADI AAYE NA YAA RAB MAI RAHUN BHAAI NA HO
english translation text: LET ZAINAB NEVER BE LEFT ALONE IN THE DESERT OF KARBALA\nO LORD, LET THAT MOMENT NEVER COME, THAT I AM LEFT BEHIND AND MY BROTHER IS GONE

arabic text: CHAADARE CHHINJAAYE GHAR LUTJAAYE HAM HOJAAYE QAID\nEHLE BAIT-E MUSTAFAA KI AISI RUSWAAI NA HO
english translation text: LET OUR VEILS BE SNATCHED, OUR HOME LOOTED, LET US BE TAKEN PRISONER\nONLY LET THE FAMILY OF THE PROPHET NOT BE SHAMED LIKE THIS

arabic text: REHGAYI MAI GHAM UTHHAANE LUTGAYAA SAB GHAR KAA GHAR\nBOLI SUGHRAA IS KHABAR MEN KAASH SACHCHAAI NA HO
english translation text: I AM LEFT BEHIND TO CARRY THE GRIEF, OUR WHOLE HOME IS DESTROYED\nSUGHRA SAID, LET THIS NEWS HOLD NO TRUTH

arabic text: UMME LAILAA KEHTITHI YAA MUJHKO BHI AAJAYE MOUT\nYAA ALI AKBAR NE SINE PAR SINAA KHAAI NA HO
english translation text: UMM-E-LAILA KEPT SAYING, EITHER LET DEATH COME TO ME TOO\nOR LET IT NOT BE TRUE THAT ALI AKBAR TOOK THE SPEAR TO HIS CHEST

arabic text: SOCHAA SHEHNE KHAAK SE UTHHNE KI KOSHISH HO YE KAASH\nMOUT KI AAGHOSH ME AKBAR KI ANGDAAI NA HO
english translation text: THE KING THOUGHT, LET HIM TRY TO RISE FROM THE DUST\nLET THIS BE AKBAR JUST STIRRING, NOT DYING IN DEATH'S ARMS

arabic text: DAFN KARKE LAASH ASGHAR KI KAHAA SHABBIR NE\nKOI GULSHAN KI KALI IS TARHA KUMLAAI NA HO
english translation text: AFTER BURYING ASGHAR'S BODY, HUSSAIN SAID\nLET NO FLOWER BUD OF ANY GARDEN EVER WILT LIKE THIS

arabic text: KHAAK PAR BAITHHI YE ZAINAB KEHTI THI BAADE HUSAIN\nSHAAME GHURBAT IS TARHA DUSHMAN PE BHI CHHAAI NA HO
english translation text: SITTING ON THE GROUND AFTER HUSSAIN, ZAINAB WOULD SAY\nLET NOT EVEN AN ENEMY FACE SUCH A NIGHT OF LONELINESS AND GRIEF

arabic text: SHAAM DHALTE HI MADINE MEN YE KEHTITHI RUBAAB\nMERI BACHCHI SHAAM KE ZINDAAN MEN GHABRAAI NA HO
english translation text: AS EVENING FELL IN MADINA, RUBAB WOULD SAY\nLET MY LITTLE GIRL NOT BE SCARED IN THE PRISON OF SHAAM
